use: Offline posterior audit of a grammar-constrained PL unmasking step when only commitments/order are retained. Independent latent completions estimate bounded functions (e.g. probability of a discarded alternative) without an unknown burn-in or storing the original discarded proposal.

scientific_questions.real_use: Diagnostics of confidence/order selection and conditional discarded-token uncertainty in dLLM JSON generation; not faster final decoding.
scientific_questions.significance: Reuse the written conditional-law and polynomial bit-cost guarantee. Bulk sampling is an application, not itself a new theorem or priority claim.
scientific_questions.competent_controls: All three exact iid controls already frozen: optimally bounded BaseRejection, SingleTilt and independent enumeration when its Cartesian cap admits it. FactorDLM/EPIC are not implementations of this conditional PL operation. Stationary MH needs the original discarded proposal; without it, a marginal target-law claim after one step is invalid.
scientific_questions.math: For 1024 iid bounded values, Hoeffding gives a <=0.043 half-width at 95% confidence. This explains the sample count without choosing it from measured throughput. The note supplies exact law and <=2J+1 expected proposals, but wall-time superiority needs measurement.
scientific_questions.honesty: Run all nine inputs/48 native events, same fixed native order and evidence as earlier campaigns. No event selected by a win. This is development on previous inputs, not independent evidence of generalization or training convergence.
scientific_questions.cost: Cold preparation, compilation, 1024 samples, integer arithmetic and process CPU time. First-output losses remain losses. Three rotated repetitions, desktop load recorded. Query limits and refusals retained.
scientific_questions.objection: Preparing many components can dominate even for 1024 draws; faster weighted sampling or sum-profile algorithms can erase gains. A Gibbs chain can be more appropriate for approximate audits and correlated averages. Independence only matters if the application needs its guarantees.
scientific_questions.publication: A measured narrow bulk benefit would confirm a use, not establish new theory, publication relevance or improvement of EPIC generation. Keep both this and the neural experiment in the final decision.

cases: All original M34 inputs and original native seeds/events from protocol.json; no replacements
numeric_variant: full-dyadic, same certified approximation on mixture and single coefficient
records: Validate every draw with independent JSON recognition/support/evidence. Store original-ID position histograms and SHA256 of ordered token paths instead of large traces; record all attempts, CPU/wall times, failures, producer and load. Exact replay from seed/code/inputs is opt-in.
success: Smaller complete CPU resource cost and wall cost on a stated paired native event, preserved iid law; report all losses and resource refusals. Small contested time differences do not count as robust superiority.
